card.name: Dates and phrases in military history
card.fires_on: Spaces and digits inside dates (e.g. 'March 8, 1862', 'December 7, 1941') and small linking words in military descriptions, in war-history and aircraft web text.

modes.label: Dates in war history
modes.description: The gap or digit right after a month or inside a day number in a battle or war date.

modes.label: Linking words in military text
modes.description: Small words like 'in', 'of' or 'to' inside fighter-aircraft or army-unit descriptions.

card.writes: It pushes toward rare or non-military continuations and away from military unit words like regiment, troops and battalion.
card.plain: It fires on dates and small words in war-history passages, just before the text would name military units.
